summary: Desktop windows, accessible controls, batched input, capture and clicks on X11 and Wayland (desktop bridge).

help:
Usage: ui [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Desktop windows, controls, capture and targeted input (Wayland with the
  desktop bridge, or X11). Inspect first; batch known actions with run.

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  inspect   Compact control map: IDs, roles, focus/editability, actions...
  act       Act on a control; return its window's compact state.
  run       Run 1-20 known actions, stop on error, inspect once at the end.
  windows   List windows and focus.
  shot      Capture a screenshot.
  grab      Capture package: image, optional OCR, geometry, and...
  gif       Record a bounded GIF (X11 grab, or Mutter ScreenCast/PipeWire...
  crop      Crop a region out of a saved image at full resolution.
  ocr       Read text from a window or image via OCR.
  diff      Compare two images; report differing-pixel count and percentage.
  activate  Focus/raise a window.
  move      Move a window.
  resize    Resize a window.
  close     Ask a window to close (WM_DELETE_WINDOW).
  click     Move the pointer and click.
  type      Type literal text; -w targets and returns compact state.
  key       Send a key/chord; -w targets and returns compact state.
  clip      Read or write the clipboard.
help.inspect:
Usage: ui inspect [OPTIONS] [target]

  Compact control map: IDs, roles, focus/editability, actions and bounded
  text.

Arguments:
  target  Window/control ID (ax:, or wl: window id) or unique title; default
          focused

Options:
  --all                     Inspect all accessible windows; shared output
                            limit
  --limit <int range>       Maximum controls  [default: 40; 1<=x<=200]
  --text-limit <int range>  Characters per value  [default: 120; 1<=x<=1000]
  --help                    Show this message and exit.
help.act:
Usage: ui act [OPTIONS] {target} [action] [value]

  Act on a control; return its window's compact state. Default needs one
  action.

Arguments:
  target  Control ID from inspect  [required]
  action  Exposed action name, focus, or set  [default: default]
  value   Text for set

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.run:
Usage: ui run [OPTIONS] {actions}

  Run 1-20 known actions, stop on error, inspect once at the end.

  JSON: {"window":"<id>","steps":[{"op":"type","text":"hi"},{"op":"key","keys"
  :"Tab"}]} Steps: activate; type/text; key/keys; act/target/action/value.
  Optional target overrides window.

Arguments:
  actions  JSON object or @file  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.windows:
Usage: ui windows [OPTIONS]

  List windows and focus. Wayland with the desktop bridge: real geometry,
  stacking and wl:/ax: ids.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.shot:
Usage: ui shot [OPTIONS]

  Capture a screenshot. Default target is the focused window.

  Wayland (bridge): the window's frame, also when covered; not minimized
  windows. --region crops image pixels. Examples: st ui shot | st ui shot -w
  aico -o /tmp/aico.png | st ui shot -w wl:12 | st ui shot --full

Options:
  -w, --window <str>  Window id or name substring
  --full              Capture the whole screen
  --region <str>      Crop region WxH+X+Y
  -o, --out <str>     Output PNG path
  --help              Show this message and exit.
help.grab:
Usage: ui grab [OPTIONS]

  Capture package: image, optional OCR, geometry, and cheapest-first index
  (X11 or bridge).

  Read text first; crop the native image for small details. Example: st ui
  grab -w aico

Options:
  -w, --window <str>  Window id or name substring
  --full              Capture the whole screen
  --region <str>      Crop region WxH+X+Y
  -o, --out <str>     Output package directory
  --ocr / --no-ocr    Include an OCR text representation  [default: ocr]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
help.gif:
Usage: ui gif [OPTIONS]

  Record a bounded GIF (X11 grab, or Mutter ScreenCast/PipeWire on Wayland).
  Example: st ui gif -w aico -t 6 -o /tmp/demo.gif

  Background this command when driving an interaction during recording. On
  Wayland a window recording is its screen rectangle (it does not follow a
  moved window or hide what covers it).

Options:
  -w, --window <str>      Window id or name substring
  --full                  Capture the whole screen
  --region <str>          Capture region WxH+X+Y
  -t, --duration <float>  Seconds to record  [default: 8.0]
  --fps <int>             Frames per second  [default: 12]
  --width <int>           Output width in px (0 = native, keeps aspect)
                          [default: 960]
  -o, --out <str>         Output GIF path
  --help                  Show this message and exit.
help.crop:
Usage: ui crop [OPTIONS] {image} {region}

  Crop a region out of a saved image at full resolution.

  The companion to `st ui grab`: when the package image is downscaled for
  vision, crop the region of interest from the native file so its text reads
  cleanly.

  Examples: st ui crop /tmp/cap/image.png 600x300+1200+800 -o /tmp/roi.png

Arguments:
  image   Source image path  [required]
  region  Crop region WxH+X+Y (pixels in the source image)  [required]

Options:
  -o, --out <str>  Output PNG path
  --help           Show this message and exit.
help.ocr:
Usage: ui ocr [OPTIONS] [target]

  Read text from a window or image via OCR. Default target is the focused
  window.

  Examples: st ui ocr | st ui ocr aico | st ui ocr /tmp/shot.png

Arguments:
  target  Window id/name or image path; default = focused window

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.diff:
Usage: ui diff [OPTIONS] {a} {b}

  Compare two images; report differing-pixel count and percentage.

  Examples: st ui diff a.png b.png | st ui diff a.png b.png -o /tmp/diff.png

Arguments:
  a  First image  [required]
  b  Second image  [required]

Options:
  -o, --out <str>  Diff image path
  --help           Show this message and exit.
help.activate:
Usage: ui activate [OPTIONS] {target}

  Focus/raise a window. Example: st ui activate aico | st ui activate wl:12

Arguments:
  target  Window id or name substring  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.move:
Usage: ui move [OPTIONS] {target} {x} {y}

  Move a window. Example: st ui move aico 100 100 | st ui move wl:12 0 0

Arguments:
  target  Window id or name substring  [required]
  x       X position  [required]
  y       Y position  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.resize:
Usage: ui resize [OPTIONS] {target} {w} {h}

  Resize a window. Example: st ui resize aico 1200 800 | st ui resize wl:12
  800 600

Arguments:
  target  Window id or name substring  [required]
  w       Width  [required]
  h       Height  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.close:
Usage: ui close [OPTIONS] {target}

  Ask a window to close (WM_DELETE_WINDOW). Example: st ui close aico | st ui
  close wl:12

Arguments:
  target  Window id or name substring  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.click:
Usage: ui click [OPTIONS] {x} [y]

  Move the pointer and click. Examples: st ui click 1200 800 | st ui click
  ax:1.42:77 | st ui click -w wl:12 40 60

  Coordinates are desktop pixels as `st ui windows` shows them (global logical
  px on Wayland).

Arguments:
  x  X coordinate, or a control id (ax:...) to click its centre (bridge)
     [required]
  y  Y coordinate

Options:
  -b, --button <int>       Mouse button (1=left,2=mid,3=right)  [default: 1]
  -w, --window <str>       X and Y are relative to this window's frame
                           (bridge)
  -n, --count <int range>  Clicks in a row (bridge)  [default: 1; 1<=x<=3]
  --help                   Show this message and exit.
help.type:
Usage: ui type [OPTIONS] {text}

  Type literal text; -w targets and returns compact state. No implicit Enter.

Arguments:
  text  Text to type  [required]

Options:
  -w, --window <str>  Target ID/title; focus and verify before input
  --help              Show this message and exit.
help.key:
Usage: ui key [OPTIONS] {keys}

  Send a key/chord; -w targets and returns compact state. Names: Return, Tab,
  ctrl+c.

Arguments:
  keys  Key/chord, e.g. ctrl+c or Return  [required]

Options:
  -w, --window <str>  Target ID/title; verify focus before input
  --help              Show this message and exit.
help.clip:
Usage: ui clip [OPTIONS] {action} [text]

  Read or write the clipboard. Examples: st ui clip get | st ui clip set "hi"

Arguments:
  action  get | set  [required]
  text    Text to set (for 'set')

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

usage.when: desktop controls; windows lists IDs, run batches actions
precautions: Use IDs; inspect after changes; never replay partial batches. On Wayland, windows/shot/grab/ocr/gif/click/move/resize/close/activate use the desktop bridge extension (wl: ids; ax_id joins AT-SPI); without it only inspect/act/run/type/key work and position/stack are unknown.

usage.when: batch known desktop actions; one final control map
precautions: 1-20 steps: activate, type, key, act. Use accessibility IDs from inspect; stop and inspect after partial failure.

usage.when: record a short animated GIF of a window/region — UI demos, bug repros, PR/launch evidence
precautions: ffmpeg palette encode of x11grab (X11) or a Mutter ScreenCast/PipeWire recording (Wayland, needs the desktop bridge); -t bounds the recording. For an interaction demo run it backgrounded and drive `st ui click/type/key` during the window
the GIF is publishable output — pre-stage panes and keep secrets/real paths off-screen
--width caps output width (default 960; 0 = native), --fps default 12; longer/wider/faster = larger file
